task: Independent constructive and counterexample attack on bounded-Holevo approximate 2-broadcasting to common EB reconstruction
overall_status: unresolved_open_target; no qualifying counterexample or unrestricted lift proved

claims.exact_statement: For every d>=2, the symmetric universal 1->2 qudit cloner has a tracial UCP, self-adjoint, positive, self-compatible depolarizing marginal Phi_d with traceless eigenvalue (d+2)/(2(d+1)). The Haar measure-and-prepare EB channel Psi_d has traceless eigenvalue 1/(d+1), and I-Psi_d=2(I-Phi_d). No admissible EB Loewner comparator can satisfy the inequality with c<2, by unitary twirling and the separability bound on isotropic Choi overlap.
assumptions: finite matrix algebra M_d with normalized trace
Dirichlet comparison is on L2(normalized trace)
EB comparator is in the proposed measurement-channel/Loewner-comparison class
claims.status: internal_exact_derivation; universal-cloning action and optimality are established prior results; external proof review of this application not obtained
claims.novelty_boundary: Calibration and sharpness only. It proves neither the factor-2 lift for all compatible channels nor the bounded-Holevo implication.
claims.costs: Exact finite-dimensional channel and Haar measurement formulas; no efficient finite implementation or acquisition cost claim.
claims.falsifier: A derivation error in the symmetric-cloner partial trace, the EB Haar integral, or the twirled isotropic-Choi separability constraint.
claims.next_gate: Search for a positive self-adjoint self-compatible channel whose low-Dirichlet modes cannot be retained by one EB measurement; this cloner is the c=2 benchmark.

claims.exact_statement: For the full tracial likelihood ball rho_H=(I+H)/d with H=H*, tau(H)=0 and ||H||_infinity<=theta<1, C(E)<=ln(1+theta). For even d, the optimal two-output marginal broadcast error is theta*d/[4(d+1)] and the optimal EB reconstruction error is theta*d/[2(d+1)] for the full ball. Hence bounded total Holevo capacity alone does not imply EB reconstruction; the broadcast-error premise is load-bearing.
assumptions: one full-domain CPTP broadcaster or EB channel
even d for exact balanced-sign attainment
claims.status: internally derived from exact covariance/twirling and Keyl-Werner universal-cloner optimality
claims.novelty_boundary: This is not a counterexample to C(E)<=C and b2(E)->0 implying eEB(E)->0; the broadcaster error tends to theta/4, not zero.
claims.costs: Finite-dimensional mathematical family; total Holevo bound is in nats and is uniform in dimension.
claims.falsifier: A better covariant compatible marginal shrinkage than the universal 1->2 cloner, or a larger covariant EB shrinkage than 1/(d+1).
claims.next_gate: Any target counterexample must add vanishing broadcasting error while retaining a constant EB error and bounded total Holevo information.

claims.exact_statement: For a finite tracial algebra and a UCP, trace-preserving, positive self-adjoint, self-compatible Phi, every pair of Hermitian contractions A,C satisfies ||[Phi^m(A),Phi^m(C)]||_(2,tau) <= 2/sqrt(m+1)+4/(m+1). The bound is dimension- and reference-weight-independent.
assumptions: Phi is UCP, trace preserving, positive self-adjoint on L2 and self-compatible
normalized L2 norm from the faithful trace
claims.status: independently reconstructed internal operator estimate; not external-review certified
claims.novelty_boundary: This gives uniform approximate commutation of the entire CP range of Phi^m, not a common EB approximation. The recovery inequality used upstream is established prior art.
claims.costs: Pure operator argument; Phi^m is compatible with 2^m outputs, while the broadcaster tree size grows exponentially in m.
claims.falsifier: A failure of the spectral maxima d_m=m^m/(m+1)^(m+1), the Kadison-defect identity, or the Stinespring multiplicative-defect bound.
claims.next_gate: Prove a dimension-free EB rounding theorem for UCP maps whose entire range has this commutator bound, or directly show beta_m->0 in the report.

claims.exact_statement: For the pure dyadic copy ladder with H=direct_sum_(j=0)^(L-1) Sym^(2^j)(C^d), its Haar-orbit Holevo information is (1/L) sum_j ln binom(d+2^j-1,2^j). At d=L*2^(L-1), this is at least (2^(L-1)/L) ln L, so the N61 vanishing-broadcast-error / EB-error-to-one witness does not satisfy a uniform total Holevo bound. N69 additionally reports scoped capacity-restricted ladder estimates eEB=O(((C+1)/L)^(1/4)) for pure ladders and O(sqrt(C/L)) for the mixed bosonic ladder.
assumptions: Haar direction orbit, or finite priors approximating its mean
d=L*2^(L-1) for the displayed diverging lower bound
claims.status: Haar capacity formula and lower bound independently derived; capacity-restricted estimates are source-derived/unreviewed Astra results
claims.novelty_boundary: Excludes the known copy-ladder route under the bounded-Holevo premise; it does not settle other state families.
claims.costs: The ladder Hilbert space and finite designs grow rapidly; no efficient acquisition or implementation is claimed.
claims.falsifier: A different total-information convention under which the Haar orbit has uniformly bounded Holevo information, or an error in the direct-sum entropy calculation.
claims.next_gate: Construct a bounded-capacity family with vanishing marginal broadcast error by a mechanism not based on a rare high-copy sector, and prove a lower bound against every common measurement.

claims.exact_statement: For all finite tracial algebras and all positive self-adjoint self-compatible UCP maps Phi, whether there is a dimension-free common EB reconstruction modulus from uniform vanishing full-trace residual on a bounded likelihood family, or a universal finite c and one canonical EB Psi with I-Psi<=c(I-Phi), remains unresolved in the supplied evidence. Failure of the special c=2 claim alone would not refute the qualitative reconstruction target.
assumptions: central faithful reference reduced to a normalized trace
likelihoods I+H with H centered Hermitian and ||H||_infinity<=1/2
full-trace residual and one common EB map
claims.novelty_boundary: No theorem or counterexample claimed. N92 covers explicit POVM/Luders and supplied bistochastic-instrument constructions, not every compatible channel.
claims.costs: General exact reference spectra, channel descriptions, and decoder runtime are not acquired or bounded by the abstract reduction.
claims.falsifier: A full proof of beta_m->0 or the proposed common-measurement variance lift resolves the positive direction; a sequence with bounded C, residual->0 and liminf eEB>0 resolves it negatively.
claims.next_gate: Attack uniform EB rounding of the entire Phi^m range, or construct the specified tracial witness sequence.

validation.result: PASS for exact Fraction identities in d=2,3,4,5,8,16,32,64; all ratios equal 2 and each tested c<2 fails.
validation.scope: Formula consistency only; the analytic derivations and prior theorem provide the mathematical argument.
